spots.name: The Dalí Museum
spots.blurb: Major Salvador Dalí collection by the bay; open daily 10 a.m.–6 p.m., Thursdays until 8 p.m.
spots.blurbEs: Gran colección de Salvador Dalí junto a la bahía; abre a diario de 10 a.m. a 6 p.m., los jueves hasta las 8 p.m.

spots.name: St. Pete Pier
spots.blurb: Free waterfront pier park for a walk with bay views
spots.blurbEs: Parque gratuito sobre el muelle para pasear con vistas a la bahía

spots.name: St. Pete Saturday Morning Market
spots.blurb: Saturday market with local food, produce and crafts, 9 a.m.–2 p.m. October through May
spots.blurbEs: Mercado de los sábados con comida local, productos y artesanía, de 9 a.m. a 2 p.m. de octubre a mayo
